What Is 1-800-GOT-JUNK? And Why Choose Them?

From large furniture to electronics, they'll take it all and dispose of it responsibly. Their services include:

  • Junk removal and disposal

With 1-800-GOT-JUNK?, you can trust that your unwanted items will be handled professionally and disposed of in an environmentally friendly manner. So, what sets them apart from their competitors? Here are some key benefits:

Veteran Discounts and Promotions

At 1-800-GOT-JUNK?, they appreciate the sacrifices made by our military personnel and their families. As a veteran, you may be eligible for discounts on junk removal services. Here are some ways veterans can save:

  • Military promotions: Keep an eye on the 1-800-GOT-JUNK? website for special promotions and discounts offered to military personnel and their families.
  • Charitable programs: Some 1-800-GOT-JUNK? franchises partner with local charities to support military families and veterans. They may offer discounted or free services to eligible individuals.

How to Get a Veteran Junk Removal Discount

Getting a veteran junk removal discount from 1-800-GOT-JUNK? is easy. Here's how:

  1. Contact your local 1-800-GOT-JUNK? franchise: Reach out to your nearest 1-800-GOT-JUNK? location to ask about available discounts. They'll guide you through the process and let you know what you're eligible for.
  2. Provide proof of military service: You may need to provide proof of military service, such as a DD Form 214 or a veterans ID card, to verify your eligibility.
  3. Book your service: Once you've confirmed your discount, book your junk removal service with 1-800-GOT-JUNK?. They'll take care of the rest.
